title: Irish Oat Bowl
description: A hearty and comforting breakfast bowl made with steel-cut oats, Irish bacon, and fresh fruit.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add the steel-cut oats and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the water.
While the oats are cooking, cook the Irish bacon in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Slice the banana and apple into thin pieces.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cooked oats, honey, and a pinch of nutmeg.
Serve the oat mixture in a bowl topped with the crispy Irish bacon, sliced banana, and apple slices.
